Frontend smoke: Esri dark-gray tiles load (48 tiles, no 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark), Projects panel shows 4463, Formalities mode shows 285 EEZ rows / 302 EEZ polygons / 106 PoE cluster markers / working zone popup (Sao Tome, 4 PoE, source link), zero console errors.

minor.issue: SPEC FAILURE: is_duplicate({'title':'Port de Papeete',lat -17.535,lon -149.57}, {'title':'Papeete Port',lat -17.536,lon -149.571}) returns False (expected True). Distance is 0.15 km (<0.5 km) but text_similarity uses raw difflib on the unnormalised strings -> 0.5185 < SIM_THRESHOLD_LOW 0.60. Consequence: word-reordered port names within 500 m are NOT deduplicated and get inserted twice by upsert_with_dedup/generate_zone_poe. Fix: compare on normalize_name() (or token_set/sorted tokens) inside text_similarity, e.g. max(raw_ratio, ratio(normalize_name(a), normalize_name(b)), token-sorted ratio). normalize_name() is currently defined but never used by the similarity path.

Terrestrial control text ('mountain forest timber alpine farmland') returns score 0.2217, above the spec threshold of <0.2 (marine=false is correct). Weak-supervision negatives (n_neg=892 vs n_pos=4462) are imbalanced; consider class_weight='balanced' or more negatives if a hard 0.2 margin is required.

summary.by_status shows ia=164 (+1 ia_sans_source) instead of the 165 'ia' expected by the test brief. Zone 8397 is ia_sans_source because its only source (smf.st) is not in the gov.st whitelist — so the 'ia' count is 164. Informational, no data loss.

Response shapes are inconsistent across the API surface (report nests counters under 'summary', zones listing uses 'items', generate status uses 'logs_tail' while ml jobs use 'logs'/'summary'). Harmless but forces per-endpoint client code.

rca_of_the_issue: dedup_core.text_similarity() applies difflib.SequenceMatcher to the raw lowercased strings; 'port de papeete' vs 'papeete port' yields 0.5185, below SIM_THRESHOLD_LOW (0.60), so is_duplicate() returns False even though haversine distance is 0.153 km. The module already exposes normalize_name() (which reduces both to 'portdepapeete'/'papeeteport') but never uses it in the similarity comparison, so name-order/stop-word variants escape dedup and can be inserted as separate PoE by generate_zone_poe/upsert_with_dedup.
